# Atunile Organics
> Vitellaria nilotica seed butter (INCI: Vitellaria nilotica seed butter), wild-harvested from the Nile Basin, Northern Uganda. Geographically exclusive to Uganda and South Sudan — approximately 1% of global shea exports.

## Business status
Atunile Organics is a B2B export supplier to cosmetics, pharmaceutical, and food/nutraceutical manufacturers. Certifications: UNBS certified (Permit No. 24969-1822-0030). REX registered (EU Registered Exporter System). EUDR pre-compliant. Organic certification (ECOCERT Africa) in progress, target end 2026.

## Pricing
Tiered EXW Kampala pricing: 5kg USD 11.94/kg, 10kg USD 10.61/kg, 20kg USD 10.50/kg, 50-100kg USD 9.82/kg, 100kg+ contact for pricing. CIF Entebbe USD 9.48/kg. Minimum order quantity: 5kg. Full negotiated terms available on request via KYC (application, buyer type, destination market, order volume). See https://www.atunileorganics.com/#exports for inquiry contact.

## Retail
Retail sales are not yet open. Retail is planned to launch January 15, 2027. For current inquiries, B2B export is the active channel: https://www.atunileorganics.com/#exports
